## Docs checklist

A session is not complete until docs are updated — check each that applies (or note why not):

- [ ] `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — updated if structure, data flow, or dependencies changed
- [ ] `docs/DECISIONS.md` — new entry added for any real choice made (date, decision, options, why, trade-offs)
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG.md` — dated, plain-language entry added
- [ ] `docs/DATA-MODEL.md` — updated if any table, column, index, or RLS policy changed
- [ ] `docs/RUNBOOK.md` — updated if any operational procedure changed
- [ ] `docs/features/<feature>.md` — created or updated for the feature touched
